comparison: Our previous production kernels versus our shape-specialized kernels. Ratios are baseline/candidate, not comparisons against ruNNtime or Hugging Face.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, Metal 3, Chrome 155; same device for each paired comparison.
inspiration: ruNNtime small-channel direct convolution and narrow output tiling, adapted to our NCHW layout. No external runtime dependency or conversion passes.

routing.rgb: Dense 3x3, IC=3, OC=8..16, stride=2, dilation=1, padding=1, per-image output spatial size >=4096. Two pixels and four output channels per thread; filters staged once.
routing.narrow: Dense 3x3, IC divisible by four, OC=4..8, batch*output spatial size >=4096, symmetric stride 1 or 2, symmetric dilation 1 or 2, padding=dilation.
routing.direct: RGB or narrow with IC<=16 and dilation=1; dispatch dimension limits checked. Two neighboring stride-one outputs reuse a four-value input row when output width is even.
routing.tile8: Other eligible narrow convolutions use an 8x64 output tile rather than computing unused rows in a larger tile.
routing.fallback: Other shapes retain previous routing. Conditions use shapes and device dispatch limits, never GPU identifiers.

modelImpact.yolo: Two eligible convolutions: RGB input 3->16, 3x3 stride2, and 16->8, 3x3 stride1 at 160x160. FP32 model-only improvement approximately 3%; FP16 approximately 2-4% in two runs.
modelImpact.depthart: No eligible convolutions in the current model graph. Small timing differences are control noise, not an optimization claim.
modelImpact.scope: Unchanged complete model graphs, submit+sync wall time. Excludes preprocessing, postprocessing, readback of final model outputs and rendering. No graph fusion or Winograd.

validation.raw: 27 geometries per precision per run; both precisions, two runs, identical input/weight/output GPU buffers, poisoned outputs, zero differing output bytes. Includes boundary, neighboring fallback, batch, stride and dilation cases.
validation.models: Both full model outputs byte-for-byte identical to archived baseline in both precisions in both runs, using original fixture inputs.
validation.oracle: 24 additional CPU-reference tests across both precisions, including bias/no-bias, channel/spatial tails, batches, specialization thresholds and fallback routes.
validation.bugFix: Independent CPU oracle exposed an existing FP32 generic GEMM batch>1 gather bug. The batch index must be multiplied by IC. Fixed the gather to use its already-computed col_b_ic; added CPU regression coverage. Archived baseline comparisons avoid that incorrect batch>1 RGB case.
validation.checks: 233 tests passed, 2 skipped; typecheck, lint, example build and benchmark build passed.

rejected: Four pixels per thread regressed FP32 RGB and some narrow geometries; retained two pixels per thread.
method: Record commands once. Eight warmups, 51 alternating baseline/candidate samples per case. Raw kernels repeat fixed dispatches and use GPU timestamps divided by repetition count; full graphs use submit+sync wall medians. Raw inputs use deterministic fractional values whose products exercise rounding; full models use original fixture inputs. Keep within-run paired ratios because GPU clocks vary between runs.
warning: Measurements cover one adapter/browser; shape-based routing avoids GPU identifiers but does not establish universal speedups. Model timings exclude preprocessing, postprocessing and rendering.
